criterion: Reference = frame 0 of 29 NEW episodes (>= 15 frames): tip height h 120.3 mm median (sd 15.1, 84.4-134.9), tip-to-brick distance d 25.1 mm median (sd 12.7, max 65.4). Open = gripper >= 30.0. Final approach = last open run (gaps < 15 frames merged). Score = ((h - 120.3) / 15.1)^2 + (max(0, d - 25.1) / 12.7)^2. Cut = latest frame of the final approach with score <= best + 0.25. Keep [cut, end).

flag_help.no_open: the gripper never opens (>= open threshold); cut chosen on height and distance only
flag_help.no_close: the gripper never closes after its last opening: the tail contains no grasp
flag_help.multi_open: the gripper opened more than once (several approaches or a re-grasp)
flag_help.multi_descent: after the cut the tip goes below 40 mm and back above 80 mm before the close
flag_help.low_start: the best open frame is lower than every NEW frame 0 (the jaws open only during the descent)
flag_help.high_start: the best open frame is more than 30 mm higher than every NEW frame 0
flag_help.far_start: the best open frame is farther from the brick than every NEW frame 0
flag_help.no_brick: no camera brick position; distance taken from the FK tip at the close
flag_help.brick_moved: the brick's resting position and the FK tip at the close differ by more than 40 mm
